value.rationale: The result identifies a genuinely changing operational regime: the promised dynamical-TRS violation may vanish with n while the no-auxiliary protocol still uses o(2^n) queries. In the physically normalized Frobenius discrepancy, this yields the concrete sufficient resolution scale Delta_n = omega((log n/n)^(1/4)).
